driver_archetypes.rationale: Base compliant car driver; accel/decal/tau tuned to match discharge headways (M1) and stopping distances.
Car violators drawn from car distribution; share 0.1 allows queue_space_seeking capacity without dominating.
Base compliant motorcycle; share reduced to 0.8 to balance with moto_seeker and match M5/moto_density.
Moto violators drawn from moto distribution; share increased to 0.2 (sum=1 with moto_saval) and p_wrong_lane activated to match M8/moto wrong-lane share.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator); jmTimegapMinor=1.0 matches M7a release dynamics.

traci_rules.rationale: Reduce motorcycle red-running probability (M3/share/moto) from 50% to ~20% to match observed M3/share/moto=0.076; k=0 as per Saval.
Saval et al. 2023 models no early start; p=0 disables creep to match M2/early/moto baseline (rule active but inactive).
Activate wrong-lane seeking (p_wrong_lane=0.2145) to match M8/moto wrong-lane share; q=30m triggers on long queues.
High probability (0.9) for motorcycles to squeeze past standing U-turners to match field observation.
Low probability (0.1) for cars to bypass standing U-turners.
